svg.title: Persistent V2-live: requests, state and video bytes
svg.desc: CloudFront serves the browser frontend and forwards API requests. API Gateway authorizes through Media and invokes owner Lambda functions in private subnets. Each service has its own Aurora cluster. Clips of 60 s or less are encoded by a short-encode Lambda instead of Fargate. Finite Fargate encoders use public subnets and Processing SQL. SQS carries control messages; private S3 holds media bytes outside the VPC.
svg.text: Video bytes: scoped upload / playback access
Supporting services below are not drawn as packet-by-packet routes.
